nodes.name: exports.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel file re-exporting the FileTreePreview and FileTreeHoverPreview components along with their types and config from sibling files in the same directory.

nodes.name: FloatingExpandPill.tsx
nodes.summary: Small floating pill button component that toggles an expanded/collapsed state, using i18n for its optional label text.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Floating navigation control offering scroll-to-bottom, mark-all-as-read, catch-up, and follow-agent actions for a scrollable view.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Developer test/demo page that exercises the useFlowAwareness hook, recording and displaying file edits, opens, terminal commands, searches, errors, and git operations for a session.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Reusable form component system providing a Form context provider, a FormItem field wrapper with label/validation styling, and submit handling.

nodes.name: CheckoutBlockedDialog.ts
nodes.summary: Defines title/message builders and an imperative singleton dialog manager that shows a native Tauri dialog explaining why a git checkout is blocked (worktree, merge, rebase, or cherry-pick in progress).

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Imperative singleton dialog that warns the user local changes would be overwritten by a git checkout, offering stash, discard, or cancel via a native Tauri dialog.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Imperative singleton dialog prompting the user to create a branch or continue when git enters a detached HEAD state, shown via a native Tauri dialog.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Imperative singleton dialog confirming a large git push (above a commit-count threshold) before it proceeds, shown via a native Tauri dialog.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Imperative singleton dialog notifying the user that a push targets a protected branch and offering to create a pull request instead.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Imperative singleton dialog handling git pull conflicts, letting the user stash and pull, discard changes and pull, or cancel.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Imperative singleton dialog shown when a git push is rejected because the branch is behind, offering to pull-then-push, force push, or cancel.

nodes.name: index.tsx
nodes.summary: Imperative singleton dialog guiding the user through a git rebase or merge conflict, showing progress and offering resolve/abort actions via a native Tauri dialog.

nodes.name: FloatingExpandPill
nodes.summary: Renders a floating pill button that toggles expand/collapse state, showing an optional translated label.

nodes.name: FloatingScrollNav
nodes.summary: Renders floating navigation buttons for scrolling to the bottom, marking messages read, catching up, and following an active agent.

nodes.name: FlowAwarenessTest
nodes.summary: Test harness component exercising every useFlowAwareness recorder (file edit/open, terminal command, search, error, git operation) and rendering the resulting session summary.

nodes.name: FormItem
nodes.summary: Renders a single form field with label, required indicator, validation status styling, help text, and extra content, reading layout settings from FormContext.

nodes.name: Form
nodes.summary: Form container component that provides layout/label-alignment context to its FormItem children and wraps submit handling.

nodes.name: checkoutBlockedTitle
nodes.summary: Builds a dialog title string describing why a git checkout is blocked, based on the error type (worktree, merge, rebase, or cherry-pick).

nodes.name: checkoutBlockedMessage
nodes.summary: Builds a detailed dialog message explaining the specific reason a git checkout is blocked and how to resolve it.

nodes.name: CheckoutBlockedDialogManager
nodes.summary: Imperative manager exposing an open() method that shows a native Tauri message dialog explaining a blocked git checkout.

nodes.name: CheckoutConflictDialogManager
nodes.summary: Imperative manager whose open() method shows a native Tauri three-way dialog for resolving a git checkout conflict (stash, discard, or cancel).

nodes.name: DetachedHeadDialogManager
nodes.summary: Imperative manager whose open() method shows a native Tauri dialog prompting the user to create a branch or continue in a detached HEAD state.

nodes.name: LargePushConfirmDialogManager
nodes.summary: Imperative manager whose open() method confirms a large git push via a native Tauri dialog before allowing it to proceed.

nodes.name: ProtectedBranchDialogManager
nodes.summary: Imperative manager whose open() method warns via a native Tauri dialog that a push targets a protected branch.

nodes.name: PullConflictDialogManager
nodes.summary: Imperative manager whose open() method resolves a git pull conflict via a native Tauri dialog (stash, discard, or cancel).

nodes.name: PushRejectedDialogManager
nodes.summary: Imperative manager whose open() method handles a rejected git push via a native Tauri dialog (pull-then-push, force, or cancel).

nodes.name: RebaseConflictDialogManager
nodes.summary: Imperative manager whose open() method shows rebase/merge conflict progress and resolve/abort actions via a native Tauri dialog.
